question: How did Fat Man achieve a supercritical mass?
answer: Plutonium-239 is so reactive that a gun-style design would have set it off before the pieces met. So Fat Man fired 32 charges in perfect unison, within a microsecond, crushing one sphere evenly until it was dense enough for a chain reaction. The result was about 21 kilotons.
move: Not more plutonium: the same plutonium, squeezed denser from every side at once.
